newsitem.title: USA: Explosive devices found at N.J. farm.
newsitem.headline: Explosive devices found at N.J. farm.

text.p: Federal authorities said Tuesday they had found the makings for two pipe bombs, a live hand grenade and five inactive mortar rounds in a search of a farm in suburban Washington Township, New Jersey.

Stephen Haskins, a spokesman for the federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms, said the munitions were found after they were directed to the site by two men arrested in Las Vegas on counterfeiting charges Monday.
Blasting caps, a semi-automatic assault rifle and a silencer were also found in a search of the farm, an old peach orchard about 15 miles south of Philadelphia, Haskins said.
At least one of the two, Theodore Supranovicz, 32, will be charged with weapons offences, Haskins said.
